review:
The Kraken on six Megaways reels with up to 117,649 ways. Mystery symbols reveal matches, and three or more wilds start respins where wilds roam after each spin.

Three scatters give six free spins – first, you open chests for modifiers like extra spins, more roaming wilds, multipliers or minimum ways. In the bonus every wild roams, and two landing on the same spot add 1x to the multiplier. Up to 10,000x, 96.4% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
